summary: The ErrorOccurred page in the HSPnet application serves as an error message handler with localization support. It displays error messages based on configuration settings and user locale.
purpose: To manage and present error messages with localization, and provide user instructions for contacting support.

workflows.name: Error Message Display
steps: Determine if using default locale based on QueryString 'Locale'.
Set visibility of HeaderEN or HeaderFR based on locale.
Retrieve ErrorEmail from configuration settings based on locale.
Set error message text using localized resources and ErrorEmail.

business_rules: Error email addresses are stored in configuration and vary by locale.
Locale defaults to 'en-US' if not specified.
validations: Validate Locale QueryString to ensure correct cultural settings.
system_behavior: Renders error message page with localized content and appropriate contact information.
Adjusts UI culture settings based on locale query.
exceptions: Handle HttpRequestValidationException by displaying a specific message.
